title: 第14幕资深者一样杀第15幕审判时间
content_zh:
第14幕 资深者？一样杀！
放任幻影刺客在线上无压力补刀收钱的同时，邢辰带着冰女这个小尾巴去拉了一波野，让野怪引走道路上的己方士兵收了收兵线，使两军交火的位置重新回到了塔前。
而这个时候，记吃不记打的遗忘法师和风行者又出现在了几人的视野里，甚至还明目张胆的来到了天灾塔前！这种送钱的事情邢辰怎么好意思放过？！
开启焦土技能的邢辰带着冰女故技重施，绕到两人的身后又是一通输出，机关枪似的闪电链打的风行者和遗忘法师毫无还手之力，很快双双阵亡。
这一次邢辰没有贪功，让出了两个人头给暗痕的幻影刺客，使其的存款一路飙升，估计10分钟最多12分钟左右就能裸出狂战来。
4分半的时候邢辰已经收下1个一血3个助攻，再加上打野和主升吞噬的额外奖金，此时已经有了1900多块钱，立刻在家买了一个加速手套和点金手卷轴，合成了迈达斯之手即点金手。
点金手这个物品可以增加英雄30的攻击速度，同时有一个主动技能“炼金”，能够瞬间消灭一个敌方单位或者野怪并转化为190金币。
考虑到队友的技术都比较坑，邢辰担心只靠自己难以在前期杀崩对面，一旦前期没队友配合击杀少经济起不来后期可能会比较难打，所以保险起见他准备走发育的路线，靠着高级吞噬每次100和点金手一次190金币的额外收入足够他刷钱刷的飞起。
“不过在那之前……”
说着，邢辰将视野切换到了中路正在对线的宙斯和暗影萨满两人。
…………
看着再一次回到泉水里面泡澡的两个队员，正在中路把菜鸟暗影萨满虐得欲仙欲死直接压了两级的宙斯蓝蝶不禁皱起了眉头。
她这一次遇到的队友虽然有一个1300分的“高手”，但是其他几个却实在是不怎么样，风行者至少还玩过几次，使用遗忘法师的那个老头则是连电脑都不会用！还好这不是用鼠标键盘操作的游戏，而且作为新手的试炼之战身体素质也不是问题，要不然这个老头子根本就连英雄都用不起来。
现在看来虽然己方那个1300分的敌法师在基本不怎么会的流浪剑客面前补刀相当舒服，自己的宙斯发育的也不错，但是却怎么也比不过上路疯狂收割人头的幻影刺客，如果拼后期的话能不能打赢还真不好说。
“看来对方也有一个不错的队员啊……”
蓝蝶叹了口气，知道这么送下去不是个办法，必须要让这两个根本不会的家伙缩一缩了，不然指不定20分钟就能给对方送出一身的神装来，那到时候什么也别干直接投降得了。
于是，她只能使用语音通讯功能向遗忘法师和风行者命令道：“那个死老头子你给我缩在塔下，风行过来帮我！都注意别再死了！”
下达完命令之后，蓝蝶总算是松了口气，觉得这样总应该没事了吧，在才5分钟就都已经缩在塔下了，你们能越塔再杀个一两次也就得了，难道还能越塔杀人杀到崩？
显然，此时的蓝蝶对这俩队友的评价已经定性为“少死当福”，甚至就连上路的外塔掉不掉也懒得顾忌了。
就在蓝蝶为自己不成器的队友担忧的时候，她面前的兵线已经不知不觉上了天灾的河道高地，距离己方一侧的防御塔越来越远。

而蓝蝶的英雄宙斯也为了补刀而站在了河道的中央，甚至正一步步的往天灾中路一塔高地挪步——虽说是个资深者，但是作为一个老婆婆，蓝蝶的技术和意识仍然称不上太好，再加上暗影萨满这个菜鸟完全没有给她任何压力也使她失去了必要的警觉。
事实上也是如此，真正有实力的资深者玩家都是根本不屑于去给试炼之战中的那些新人菜鸟当保姆，也只有技术最末尾的资深者才会看重胜利后发给的100金币奖金。
成功拿到一个小兵的金钱，蓝蝶抬头瞄了瞄了暗影萨满的血量，正估摸着自己的伤害能不能将其杀掉的时候，突然一声晴天霹雳从她的背后响起！
直到这时蓝蝶才猛然发现自己的背后突然出现的两个代表着敌人英雄红色圆圈。
所谓人老成精，蓝蝶虽然意识差了些，可思路还是很清晰的，知道后路已经被断掉头往回逃铁定是死路一条，第一时间便顺着河道往下走。
控制着末日使者尾随而追的邢辰冷笑一声，立刻在使用通讯功能对中路的暗影萨满命令道：“留住她！”
此时暗影萨满距离宙斯并不远，一个二级枷锁技能3.25秒的控制下去宙斯脆弱的身板便倒在了三个英雄的群殴之下，化作一道祥云升天而去。
被杀回泉水的蓝蝶异常郁闷，不禁开始在公共频道里面大声怒吼起来：“你们俩放着上路的两个白痴ATM提款机不杀，来找老娘的麻烦干嘛啊！”
对于蓝蝶老太婆的愤怒邢辰只能是耸了耸肩表示同情，但是接下来该干什么还是要干什么的。
“流浪剑客，你准备一下，一会我们去抓敌法师。”邢辰和流浪剑客联络道。
“敌法师？我看看……噢，你说那个瞎子啊，行！要不是他旁边还有个牛，就那个没技能的家伙我上去两刀就砍死了！有你们在牵扯住牛我自己就能搞定那个瞎子！”
邢辰：“……”
“对了，你们刚才一直都在打野怪，打出什么好东西来了么？有啥用不着的装备分我两件呗，我在下边打了这么多兵一件装备都没掉，这普通的兵是不是不掉装备啊？”
邢辰：“…………”
“怎么不说话，你们什么时候过来啊？我6级了，开大招可牛B呢！”
邢辰揉了揉脑袋，痛苦的说道：“我改主意了，你再混混吧，我在中补下经验。”
“啊？怎么不来了？”
想要抓飞来飞去的敌法师没有配合可不行，但是就凭流浪剑客的水平……
邢辰顿时一阵无力感涌出，再也懒得去抓敌法了，与其浪费那个时间还不如干脆去混混线等到6级有了大招之后再说呢。
没有了邢辰的“搅局”上中下三条线也终于恢复了平静，各方都在补刀发育，没有再爆发什么战斗。

就在这个平静之中，6分钟的时间点到来了。
“审判时间！！！”
…………
注：宙斯：于参与到近卫军团和天灾军团的世俗争斗中，宙斯（Zeus）被众神流放到人间。虽然他的力量因此被大幅削弱，但你仍然不能小看他对于闪电的运用。同时擅长杀伤单一和多个目标，非常强大的伤害性法师英雄。
弧形闪电：释放一道会跳跃穿越附近敌人的闪电。等级4：造成145点魔法伤害，消耗魔法80点，跳跃15次。
雷击：召唤一道闪电打击一个敌方单位，造成伤害及短暂眩晕。雷击在目标周围900范围内提供真实视域。等级4：造成350点伤害，消耗魔法135点。
静电场：宙斯每次施放技能时都会电击附近所有敌方单位，造成他们当前生命一定比例的伤害。等级4：敌方生命额外减少11%。
终极技能雷神之怒：用闪电打击所有敌方英雄，无论他们在哪。雷神之怒会在每个受攻击的英雄半径900的范围内提供真实视野。隐身的英雄不会受到伤害，但你依然会获得他所在之处的真实视域。可用神杖升级。等级3：造成475（640）点伤害，消耗魔法450点。括号内为神杖升级后的数值。
content_en:
Act 14 Senior? Kill the same!
While allowing the Phantom Assassin to collect money without pressure on the line, Xing Chen used the little tail of Ice Girl to pull out a wave of wild monsters, letting the wild monsters lead away the soldiers on the road to withdraw troops, so that the position where the two armies were fighting returned to the front of the tower.
At this time, the Forgotten Mage and Windrunner, who cared not only about food but also about fighting, appeared in the sight of several people again, and even came to the Natural Disaster Tower blatantly! How could Xing Chen have the nerve to let go of giving money like this? !
Xing Chen, who activated the scorched earth skill, repeated the old trick with the Ice Girl, went around behind the two of them and fired another blast. The machine gun-like lightning chain hit Windrunner and the Forgotten Mage without the ability to fight back, and they were both killed soon after.
This time, Xing Chen didn't take credit and gave up two heads to Anhen's phantom assassin, causing his bank account to skyrocket. It was estimated that he would be able to fight naked in 10 to 12 minutes at most.
At 4 and a half minutes, Xing Chen had received one first blood and three assists. In addition to the additional bonuses from jungler and main promotion, he already had more than 1,900 yuan. He immediately bought an acceleration glove and a Midas hand scroll at home, and synthesized the Midas Hand, the Midas Hand.
The Midas Touch is an item that can increase the hero's attack speed by 30. It also has an active skill "Alchemy" that can instantly destroy an enemy unit or wild monster and convert it into 190 gold coins.
Considering that his teammates' skills are relatively poor, Xing Chen is worried that it will be difficult to defeat the opponent in the early stage by himself. If there are few teammates to cooperate with him in the early stage, and the economy is not good enough, it may be more difficult to fight in the later stage. Therefore, he is going to take the development route to be on the safe side. The additional income of 100 gold coins each time from advanced devouring and 190 gold coins from Midas touch is enough for him to farm up.
"But before that..."
As he spoke, Xing Chen switched his vision to Zeus and Shadow Shaman, who were facing each other in the middle.
…………
Seeing the two team members returning to take a bath in the spring water, Zeus Blue Butterfly, who was beating the rookie Shadow Shaman to death by two levels in the middle, couldn't help but frowned.
Although the teammates she met this time had a "master" with a score of 1300, the others were really not that good. She had played Windrunner at least a few times, and the old man who used Forgotten Mage couldn't even use a computer! Fortunately, this is not a game operated with a mouse and keyboard, and as a novice, the physical fitness of the trial battle is not an issue, otherwise this old man would not be able to use the hero at all.
Now it seems that although our anti-mage with a score of 1300 is quite comfortable in front of the wandering swordsman who is basically not good at it, and our own Zeus is also well developed, it cannot be compared to the phantom assassin who is madly harvesting heads on the road. It is hard to say whether he can win if he fights in the late stage.
"It seems that the other party also has a good team member..."
Lan Die sighed, knowing that sending him off like this was not an option. He had to make these two guys who didn't know how to shrink back. Otherwise, they might be able to give each other a magical outfit in 20 minutes. Then don't do anything and just surrender.
So, she could only use the voice communication function to order the Forgotten Mage and Windrunner: "That dead old man, hide under the tower for me, Fenghang come and help me! Be careful not to die again!"
After giving the order, Lan Die finally breathed a sigh of relief, thinking that it should be okay. In just 5 minutes, they were already huddled under the tower. You can just jump over the tower and kill once or twice. Is it possible to jump over the tower and kill people until it collapses?
Obviously, at this time, Blue Die's evaluation of the two teammates has been characterized as "less death, more blessings", and even the outer tower on the road cannot be dropped and does not bother to worry about it.
Just when Lan Die was worried about her incompetent teammates, the military line in front of her had unknowingly moved up to the river highlands of the natural disaster, getting further and further away from the defense tower on her side.
andBlue Butterfly's hero Zeus also stood in the middle of the river in order to catch up on the damage, and even moved step by step towards the height of the first tower in the middle of the natural disaster road. Although she was a veteran, as an old woman, Blue Butterfly's skills and consciousness were still not very good. In addition, the rookie Shadow Shaman did not put any pressure on her at all, causing her to lose the necessary vigilance.
In fact, this is also true. Really capable veteran players don't even bother to be nannies for the newbies in the trial battle. Only the veterans with the lowest skills will value the 100 gold coin bonus after victory.
After successfully getting a minion's money, Lan Die raised her head and took a look at the Shadow Shaman's health. Just when she was assessing whether her damage could kill him, a sudden thunderbolt sounded from behind her!
Only then did Lan Die suddenly notice that two red circles representing enemy heroes suddenly appeared behind him.
It is said that people become wiser with age. Although Lan Die's consciousness has deteriorated, his thinking is still very clear. Knowing that the escape route has been cut off, turning back and running back will definitely lead to death, so he immediately goes down the river.
Xing Chen, who controlled the Doomsday Messenger to follow him, sneered and immediately used the communication function to order the Shadow Shaman in the middle: "Keep her!"
At this time, the Shadow Shaman was not far away from Zeus. After controlling it for 3.25 seconds with a second-level shackle skill, Zeus' fragile body fell to the group fight of three heroes and turned into an auspicious cloud and ascended into the sky.
Lan Die, who was killed and returned to the spring, was extremely depressed. He couldn't help but start shouting loudly in the public channel: "You two let the two idiot ATM cash machines on the road go without killing them. Why are you causing trouble for me!"
Xing Chen could only shrug his shoulders and express sympathy for the anger of the old woman Lan Die, but he still had to do what he had to do next.
"Wandering Swordsman, get ready. We will catch the enemy mage later." Xing Chen contacted the Wandering Swordsman.
"Anti-Mage? Let's take a look... Oh, you're talking about the blind man, okay! If there wasn't a cow next to him, I would go up and kill that unskilled guy with two swords! As long as you are holding the cow in check, I can take care of the blind man myself!"
Xing Chen: "..."
"By the way, you have been fighting wild monsters just now. Did you get anything good? Give me two pieces of equipment that you don't need. I fought so many soldiers down there and didn't drop any equipment. Do these ordinary soldiers not drop equipment?"
Xing Chen: "…………"
"Why don't you say anything? When will you come over? I'm level 6, and my ultimate move is awesome!"
Xing Chen rubbed his head and said painfully: "I changed my mind, you can continue to fool around, I will make up for it with experience."
"Ah? Why don't you come?"
If you want to catch the anti-mage flying around, you can't do it without your cooperation, but with the level of the wandering swordsman...
Xing Chen suddenly felt helpless and no longer bothered to catch enemy spells. Instead of wasting that time, he might as well just go to the mixed lane and wait until he has the ultimate move at level 6.
Without Xing Chen's "disruption", the upper, middle, and lower lines finally returned to calm. All parties were working on their last hits, and no more battles broke out.
In this calmness, the 6-minute time came.
"Judgement time!!!"
…………
Note: Zeus: After participating in the secular battle between the Guards and the Scourge, Zeus was exiled to the world by the gods. Although his power is greatly weakened as a result, you still can't underestimate his use of lightning. A very powerful mage hero who is good at killing single and multiple targets.
Arc Lightning: Releases a bolt of lightning that leaps through nearby enemies. Level 4: Causes 145 points of magic damage, consumes 80 points of magic, and jumps 15 times.
Lightning Strike: Summons a bolt of lightning to strike an enemy unit, causing damage and briefly stunning it. thunderProvides true sight within 900 range around the target. Level 4: Causes 350 points of damage and consumes 135 magic points.
Static Electric Field: Every time Zeus casts a skill, he will electrocute all nearby enemy units, causing damage proportional to their current health. Level 4: The enemy's health is reduced by an additional 11%.
Ultimate Ability Thor's Wrath: Strikes all enemy heroes with lightning, no matter where they are. Thor's Wrath provides true vision within a 900 radius of each hero being attacked. The invisible hero takes no damage, but you still gain true sight of where he is. Can be upgraded with the Scepter. Level 3: Causes 475 (640) points of damage and consumes 450 magic points. The values ​​in brackets are the upgraded values ​​of the Scepter.
